summary: @servicetitan/standalone-root 1.11.5 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at install time
details: package.json declares "preinstall": "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>, unpacks it, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line obfuscated blob using a rotating string-array indirection and a several-thousand-entry constant table with a decoder function, marked // @bun @bun-cjs so it only runs under the freshly dropped Bun binary. The obfuscated payload is not referenced from dist/index.js and is unrelated to the package's declared purpose ("Root data providers for Standalone MFEs and Hosts") — a peer-dep-only React/MobX data-provider library has no need to fetch an alternate runtime and execute a large obfuscated blob under it at npm install time. The design routes execution through a non-Node runtime, evading Node-based supply-chain scanners. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: installing the package auto-executes attacker-shipped obfuscated code on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
